parse.title: Corrupted Cave Field
parse.wikitext:
{{Quote | quote=''Corruption seeps from every crevice!''}}
[[File:BattlebgCorrupted.png|thumb]]

Corrupted Cave is a field effect exclusive to Rejuvenation. It is categorized as a Synthetic field and can be found in the [[Corrupted Cave (Location)|Corrupted Cave]] (near Carotos Mountain), and while fighting [[Rift Garbodor]] in [[West Gearen Sewage Management]].

==Transitions From Other Fields==

* [[Cave]] will transform into this field if either Acid Downpour or Sludge Wave is used.
** ''The cave was corrupted!''

==General Effects==

* Poison-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x.
** ''The chemicals strengthened the attack.''
* Grass-type moves increase in base power by 1.2x.
** ''The corruption morphed the attack!''
* Rock-type moves increase in base power by 1.2x.
** ''The corruption morphed the attack!''
* Fairy-type moves decrease in base power by 0.5x.
** ''The corruption weakened the attack.''
* Non-contact Flying-type moves decrease in base power by 0.5x.
** ''The cave choked out the air!''
* All grounded non-Poison or Steel-type Pokémon on the field are poisoned at the end of each turn.
** Pokémon with one of the abilities Immunity, Pastel Veil, or Wonder Skin are immune.

==Abilities Affected==

* Corrosion additionally boosts damage dealt by 1.5x.
* Dry Skin causes the bearer to lose 1/8 max HP each turn if it isn't Poison or Steel-type, and recover 1/8 of its maximum HP each turn if it is Poison-type.
* Flower Veil, Grass Pelt, and Leaf Guard additionally damage the bearer for 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.
** ''[Pokémon]'s foliage caused harm!''
* Liquid Ooze does double damage on activation.
* Mimicry changes the user's type to Poison.
* Poison Heal additionally heals the bearer for 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.
** ''[Pokémon] was healed in the corruption!''
* Poison Point and Poison Touch have their activation rate doubled to 60%.
* Toxic Boost's damage boost increases to 2x.

==Moves Affected==

===Moves which receive an attack buff===

* Apple Acid, Seed Flare → 1.5x boost.
** ''The move absorbed the filth!''

===Other moves===

* Diamond Storm, Rock Slide, Rock Tomb, Smack Down, and Stone Edge gain a Poison sub-typing.
** As of v13.5.6, the field effect manual incorrectly states that Apple Acid gains a Poison sub-typing.
* Gunk Shot and Sludge Wave gain a Rock sub-typing.
* Ingrain damages the user instead, unless they are Poison or Steel-type.
* Stealth Rock deals Poison-type scaling damage instead.
** ''[Pokémon] was hurt by the corrupted stealth rocks!''
* Tar Shot additionally inflicts Poison.
* Toxic Thread inflicts Bad Poison instead.

===Field-dependent moves===

* Camouflage changes the user's type to Poison.
* Nature Power becomes Gunk Shot.
* Secret Power may inflict Poison.
* Shelter halves damage from Poison-type moves.
* Terrain Pulse's type becomes Poison.

==Transitions to Other Fields==

'''Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.'''

* This field will transform into [[Cave]] if any of the moves Purify, Seed Flare, Solar Beam, or Solar Blade are used.
** ''The cave was purified!''
* This field will transform into [[Volcanic Field]] if any of the following moves are used, damaging all active Pokémon by 50% of their max HP.
** Blast Burn, Eruption, Heat Wave, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume
*** ''The cave's corruption combusted!''

==Items==

* [[Synthetic Seed]] boosts Defense by 2 stages but Badly Poisons the user.
* Black Sludge's effect is doubled.
